source: convention: deep lunge (front thigh near horizontal), left foot forward, back knee off the floor, both hands on the floor inside the front foot; the trunk turns open to the left on the pelvis (about 45 degrees) and lifts a little as the left arm sweeps out and reaches to the ceiling, the right hand staying planted, then returns (reps on one side; both arms written so the right one keeps its hand on the floor while the trunk turns); angles UNSOURCED
